title: Bait the contraction vault into a fast drain
teach: Force a contraction close so the vault fills, then run a full day of hourly buybacks. Every single hour is capped at min(10% of the vault, 0.2% of the pool), so the vault cannot be emptied into the pool in one move — and it never sells gold to fund one.

actions.note: 20 ETH in, so the fee bucket has something to split
25 ETH out: net flow goes negative
close contraction; 70% of fee income funds the contraction vault
